description: Shared mock conformance corpus (#4742, PMR-1.2). Every deployment of the mock runtime - the in-process app, `apiome mock run`, and the official container image - must answer these requests identically while serving conformance_data/bundle.json.

cases.name: health-is-reserved-and-live
cases.why: Liveness probe answers at the runtime root, never routed to the spec.

cases.name: ready-reports-the-served-bundle
cases.why: Readiness identifies exactly which bundle is being served, so CI can assert the pin.

cases.name: list-serves-the-spec-example
cases.why: Example-first resolution: a declared response example is returned verbatim.

cases.name: path-parameters-route-to-the-item-operation
cases.why: Templated paths match concrete segments and resolve the item response.

cases.name: unmatched-path-is-a-problem-404
cases.why: Unknown routes fail as RFC 7807 problem+json, not as a framework error page.

cases.name: wrong-method-is-405-with-allow
cases.why: A known path with an unknown method reports the methods that do exist.

cases.name: query-parameter-validation-rejects-out-of-range
cases.why: Request validation runs against the pinned spec and reports the violation location.

violations.message: <root>: 0 is less than the minimum of 1

cases.name: missing-required-body-is-rejected
cases.why: A required request body is enforced before any response is resolved.

cases.name: create-returns-the-declared-201-example
cases.why: Non-GET operations resolve their own declared success status and example.

cases.name: prefer-header-forces-a-declared-status
cases.why: Prefer: code=<status> selects any response the spec declares.

cases.name: forcing-an-undeclared-status-is-refused
cases.why: The mock never invents a response the contract does not declare.

cases.name: no-content-response-has-an-empty-body
cases.why: A 204 stays a 204 with nothing in the body.

cases.name: unsatisfiable-accept-is-406
cases.why: Content negotiation refuses rather than silently returning the wrong media type.

cases.name: scenario-header-serves-the-canned-response
cases.why: Bundled scenarios override the default response, headers included.

cases.name: scenario-sequences-advance-per-session
cases.why: A multi-response scenario walks its sequence, tracked by X-Mock-Session.

cases.name: unknown-scenario-is-refused-with-the-available-list
cases.why: A typo in X-Mock-Scenario fails loudly and says what does exist.

cases.name: chaos-error-injection-serves-the-declared-5xx
cases.why: Injected failures still come from the contract, marked with X-Mock-Chaos.

cases.name: chaos-delay-is-reported-on-the-response
cases.why: An injected delay is observable, so a client can tell latency from a hang.

cases.name: session-state-is-readable-after-a-create
cases.why: Stateful CRUD works with no database behind the runtime.

cases.name: session-state-does-not-leak-between-sessions
cases.why: One session's writes are invisible to another, which is what makes CI runs isolated.

cases.name: seeded-synthesis-is-deterministic
cases.why: A schema-only response with ?__seed= must produce the same body on every runtime.

cases.name: declarative-rule-selects-and-templates-the-response
cases.why: A matching rule serves its own responses, rendered from request fields, fixture pack data, and seeded randomness (#4744).

cases.name: unmatched-rule-falls-back-to-the-scenario-responses
cases.why: When no rule's predicates hold, the override's plain responses serve instead (#4744).

cases.name: fixture-pack-listing-reports-the-pack-digest
cases.why: The lifecycle control plane publishes each pack's versioned identity so a test can pin the data it seeds (#4745).

packs.name: seeded-pets
packs.description: Two pets and the catalog values templates read.

cases.name: session-reset-to-a-pack-reports-what-it-seeded
cases.why: A reset echoes the pack digest and resource count, so a test can assert the exact state it started from (#4745).

cases.name: seeded-session-serves-the-pack-resources
cases.why: Fixture pack collections become readable session state, which is what makes a test's data deterministic (#4745).

cases.name: session-reset-without-a-pack-clears-the-session
cases.why: An empty reset discards prior writes, so cases cannot inherit each other's state (#4745).

cases.name: unknown-fixture-pack-is-refused-with-the-available-list
cases.why: A typo in the pack name fails loudly and says what does exist (#4745).

cases.name: session-reset-requires-a-session-header
cases.why: A reset names the session it clears; without one it refuses rather than guessing (#4745).

cases.name: unknown-control-path-is-refused-not-spec-routed
cases.why: The reserved __mock__ namespace never falls through to spec routing, whatever is under it (#4745).
